IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark straight
hair stands full-length against a white backdrop.
She wears a sheer lilac halter top with a deep V
neckline, covered in dark sequin and beaded floral
embroidery, with a thin beaded choker. A
distressed black leather mini skirt with studs and a
low waistband completes the look. Black strappy
mules finish the outfit. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of lilac, black,
and silver. Glamorous and edgy, in the style of an
evening fashion lookbook.
